scope: original frame preservation plus standalone assembled live-source snapshots/exact validations and pinned colour/B construction on host-model cache misses; no installed cache/scheduler/uploads/display

loading_preparation.scope: frozen live-table loading experiment with assembled snapshot/colour/B and owned high-RAM store/candidate dispatch; host scan/content selection; excludes scan, zeroing, external wrappers and hardware stalls

timing_attribution.units: ms at modeled 28 MHz, with existing per-read allowance

timing_attribution.scope: executed assembly CPU model; host work and physical waits are not timed
